scope: Explicit owner self-chat web search admission, private-query subset, cancellation handling, and truthful fallback.
method: Read-only independent review of the final source and test bytes against merged main, with confirmation that the final test tuple typing change preserves runtime cases and assertions; no edits or tests by the reviewer.
result: No material blocking findings. Self-chat web dispatch requires a direct positive request without detected cancellation or constraints; any reduced query passes the existing privacy gate and uses words from the owner request. A requested search with no result receives a truthful fallback.
remainingLimit: Lexical consent checks can reject some valid topics and cannot parse every natural-language reversal. Focused tests use synthetic provider results; live provider verification follows the merged release.
